name: @gof/worker
description: Cloudflare Worker API: public daily game + protected admin/import routes over Cloudflare D1.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply gta-florida-local --local --env local
scripts.db:migrations:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list gta-or-florida-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply gta-or-florida-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrations:list:production: wrangler d1 migrations list gta-or-florida-production --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply gta-or-florida-production --remote --env production
scripts.db:migrate:check: rm -rf .wrangler/ci-migrations-check && wrangler d1 migrations apply gta-florida-local --local --env local --persist-to .wrangler/ci-migrations-check
scripts.db:backup:staging: mkdir -p ../../backups && wrangler d1 export gta-or-florida-staging --remote --env staging --output ../../backups/d1-staging-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).sql
scripts.db:backup:production: mkdir -p ../../backups && wrangler d1 export gta-or-florida-production --remote --env production --output ../../backups/d1-production-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).sql
